titulo: Disney: $9 billion buying back its own shares, about 1,000 roles being cut. Here is the math.
caption:
Disney, Nov 17, 2026 (Shareholder letter, Form 8-K): "we do expect a portion to drop to the bottom line over time"
Disney's Nov. 17, 2026 earnings release gives $9.0 billion in fiscal 2026 buybacks and about $3 billion in annual savings by fiscal 2029. Variety reports about 1,000 roles cut in April.

Same year: $9 billion buying back its own shares, fiscal 2026. $9.0 billion of its own shares bought back across the full fiscal 2026, per the earnings release. Dividends are separate.
The math: $9 billion in buybacks (2026) ÷ about 1,000 job cuts (Variety) = about $9 million in buybacks per job cut. The roles count is approximate, per Variety.
The facts: $9 billion buying back its own shares, fiscal 2026 (Disney earnings release (SEC), Nov 17, 2026). about 1,000 roles being cut (Variety, Apr 14, 2026). The $9.0 billion is fiscal 2026 buybacks of Disney's own shares, from the earnings release; dividends are separate. The 1,000 roles are from April 2026, per Variety citing a source, not from the November results.

Efficiency is the word. Buybacks are the number. (Our take.)

Send this to someone who has been through a round of cuts.

Sources: Disney earnings release (SEC), Nov 17, 2026; Variety, Apr 14, 2026.

More at the link in bio.
